instruction: Open C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_039_threaded_insert_geometry.step in SolidWorks. Using SolidWorks command-line automation, use that input file, a cylindrical insert blank of outside diameter 16 mm, length 24 mm from Z=0 to Z=24, and a 6 mm through center hole. Create visible simplified external thread geometry over the middle 18 mm length from Z=3 to Z=21 with thread outside diameter 16 mm, root diameter 14.4 mm, and pitch 2 mm. The simplified geometry may be represented by alternating crest and root bands at the 2 mm pitch. Leave 3 mm unthreaded lead-in sections at both ends and keep the 6 mm bore through. Export C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_039_threaded_insert_out.step. [Software] Launch SOLIDWORKS from `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\` (use your actual executable or shortcut).
